theorems.name: Submission.bv_integral_convolution_mul_reflect
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F ρ h : Rn n → ℝ), Integrable F volume → Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → ∫ x, convolution ρ F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x * h x = ∫ x, F x * convolution (fun t ↦ ρ (-t)) h (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x
